desc:
Throw your Lucky Block… go full ragdoll !

💥 The more you throw, the more you earn
💰 The more you earn, the stronger you get

⚡ GAMEPLAY

Throw Lucky Blocks to trigger ragdoll and open them
Upgrade your Power 💪, Heal ❤️, and Speed ⚡
Collect unique Brainrots 
Place them in your base to generate money 💸
Explore and unlock new zones 🌍

🔥 FEATURES

🌋 Dynamic events: Lava, Toxic, Galaxy
🎰 10+ rarities (Common → Secret → Divine)
🧠 50+ Brainrots to collect
🏝️ Progressive zones to unlock
🚀 Fast progression

💡 GOAL
Become the richest player, collect all brainrots, and reach the rarest zones
